title: PlotDivergence for Analyzing Sequence Identity Variation in Genetic Loci
author: Magdalena M Julkowska
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t2ieqce

steps.title: Prepare Sequence Data
steps.instruction: Download sequences of the target accessions from the 1001 genomes SALK Genome Browser DB and format them in a text editor.

substeps.instruction: Remove all '[', ']', and '-' characters from the sequences.
Ensure Col-0 is the first sequence in the file.
Save the file in 'Plain Text Module' with a .fasta extension (replacing .txt).

steps.title: Identify ORF Coordinates
steps.instruction: Determine the positions of the Open Reading Frames (ORFs) relative to the Col-0 sequence.

substeps.instruction: Copy the Col-0 sequence into a word document, ensuring no 'ENTER' breaks are present.
Highlight ORFs for all genes in the region (e.g., using different colors).
Note the position of ORFs in the format: GeneID – (start,end),(start,end) (e.g., At4g10310 – (2,200),(400,500)), using the word count pane to track character positions.

steps.title: Configure the Python Script
steps.instruction: Edit the plot_divergence.py script using a script-specific text editor (e.g., TextWrangler or Atom).

substeps.instruction: Insert the folder path/location and the filename of the .fasta file.
At the bottom of the script, enter the ORF coordinates identified in the previous step.
Enter the ORFs in duplicate; remove any unnecessary ATGs that do not need to be plotted as ORFs.

steps.title: Execute the Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the script using the Python launcher or command line.

substeps.instruction: Enter 'python [path/to/script]/plot_divergence.py' in the terminal and press enter, or right-click the file and run with the Python launcher.
Allow the script to run (this may take several hours depending on sequence length and number of accessions).

steps.title: Analyze and Export Results
steps.instruction: Review the generated .svg plot file, which contains three graphs relative to Col-0.

substeps.instruction: Verify the upper graph (% of missing data), middle plot (insertions/deletions), and lower plot (% sequence identity).
Locate the individual ORF positions below the plot.
Open the .svg file in Adobe Illustrator to modify colors or add ORF directionality.
